players.bio: Aaron Evans Nemane is a 28-year-old French professional footballer who plays as a forward or right wing-back for EFL League Two club Rotherham United. His previous clubs include Notts County, Amiens SC, Manchester City and Rangers. Early life Nemane was born in Amiens, France but was raised in Blackley, Manchester.
Alex Stephen Bruce (born 28 September 1984) is a professional football coach and former player who is head coach of EFL League Two club Rotherham United.

Ar'jany Martha is a 23-year-old professional footballer who plays as a versatile winger or full-back for Eredivisie club SC Telstar, on loan from EFL League Two side Rotherham United. Martha, whose roots lie in Curaçao, joined Spartaan '20 in the south of his native city of Rotterdam during his childhood.

Brandon Ashley Cover (born 25 September 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or full-back for EFL League Two club Rotherham United . Born in England, he plays for the Jamaica national team. He has played on loan at Port Vale and Fleetwood Town.

Brandon Paul Brian Williams is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Rotherham United. Williams is a graduate of the Manchester United youth academy and made his first-team debut in September 2019. He has represented England at under-20 and under-21 levels.
Cameron Miles Dawson is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Bradford City.
Cohen Lee is a 20-year-old professional midfielder for Rotherham United F.C., currently playing on loan at non-league club Ilkeston Town F.C..

Denzel Hall (born 22 May 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL League Two club Rotherham United. Career Born in Rotterdam, Hall came through the Feyenoord Academy and, in December 2020, signed a contract until summer 2024. He made his Eredivisie debut as an 85th-minute substitute in a 4–1 win at NEC Nijmegen on 23 January 2022.
Dominic Iorfa is an English professional footballer who currently plays as a defender for Rotherham United F.C. in EFL League Two. He is the son of former Nigerian footballer Dominic Iorfa.
Emmanuel Adegboyega is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Rotherham United F.C. in the EFL.
Ewan Otoo (born 30 August 2002) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender or defensive midfielder for Rotherham United.

Fábio André Tavares Desidério (born 22 January 2001) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Rotherham United . Tavares signed his first professional contract with Rochdale. Tavares made his professional debut for Rochdale in a 3-0 EFL League One loss to Wycombe Wanderers F.C. on 28 September 2019.
Hamish Douglas is a professional footballer from England who plays as a Center Back for Rotherham Utd.

James Anthony Clarke (born 22 October 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Rotherham United. Career Rotherham United On 29 May 2025, Clarke signed his first professional contract with the club penning a two-year contract.

Jamie Jellis is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Rotherham United. He completed a free transfer to the club on 10 July 2026, signing a two-year contract following his departure from Walsall earlier in the summer.
Jayce John Fitzgerald is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Rotherham United, on loan from Premier League club Manchester United.
Jili Buyabu is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL League Two club Rotherham United, on loan from EFL Championship side Sheffield United.

Joseph Gerard Rafferty (born 6 October 1993) is a professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club Rotherham United. Rafferty can operate as a full-back and as a midfielder. He was born and raised in the city of Liverpool where he started his footballing career. Rafferty has played internationally for the Republic of Ireland three times at under-18 and once at under-19 level.

Julian Ryan Eyestone (born May 21, 2006) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Rotherham United, on loan from Premier League club Brentford. Eyestone is a product of the FC Dallas academy and the Duke Blue Devils and gained his first senior experience with North Texas SC. He began his professional career in England with Brentford in 2024.

Kane Richardson is a professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Rotherham United. He came up through the youth academy at Rotherham United and officially signed his first senior professional contract with the club on 29 May 2025.
Kian Alec Spence (born 9 January 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Rotherham United.
Kieran Ngwenya (born 25 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Rotherham United.

Klaidi Lolos is a 26-year-old Greek professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder and forward for EFL League Two side Rotherham United, on a season-long loan from EFL League One club Peterborough United. He has previously played for Plymouth Argyle where he had loan spells at Dorchester Town and Chippenham Town before joining Torquay United.

Marvin Kaleta , Rotherham United Marvin Kaleta came through the ranks at Manchester City before joining Wolves in 2020. The right-back has become a prominent feature for both Wolves’ Under 18 and Under 21 sides. A forward thinking defender, Kaleta has bags of energy and mixed with strong ball carrying ability and strength, proves to be a threat for any team he plays in.

Ossama Ashley is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two side Rotherham United. Born on 23 February 2000 in Greenwich, London, the 26-year-old is also of Jamaican and Moroccan descent.
Paul Mullin is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Rotherham United in EFL League Two. He is a product of the Everton, Liverpool and Huddersfield Town academies.

Reece Wilson is a 19-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Rotherham United FC. He progressed through the academy ranks at Rotherham and signed his first professional senior contract with the club on 29 May 2025.
Sonny Aljofree is a 21-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Rotherham United.
Ted Cann is a professional footballer from England who plays as a Goalkeeper for Rotherham Utd.

Thomas William Bradshaw (born 27 July 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Rotherham United. He has previously played for Aberystwyth Town, Shrewsbury Town and Walsall. Born in England, he represented Wales at under−19 and under−21 level before making his senior Wales debut in March 2016.
